opening.quote: Agent: Good i morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: The agent gave her name and the company name in the first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Agent: Thank you, mike. I can see a payment of €120.00 for a dining chair set.
verification.comment: Verification was requested, and the caller gave a name and postcode, but the agent then used the wrong name ('mike') and did not confirm the full name matched before disclosing order data; she should confirm identity before sharing payment details.

understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue (a bank dispute) and did not re-ask for details already given, though she should have clarified the issue more fully.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: I'll makes a note in your order you've open a dispute. Your bank will contact your with their decision.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent's statements are broadly consistent with policy, which says bank disputes are passed to the Payments team who reply within 2 working days; she did not mention this timeline or the Payments team.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Yes, you wait for your bank. I'll email you today to confirm the note on your order.
process_compliance.comment: Policy requires bank disputes to be passed to the Payments team rather than left to the bank, and the agent did not do this or mention the 2-working-day reply.

communication.quote: Customer: Thanks for letting be know, and I'm sorry you had to go to your bank over this.
communication.comment: The agent was polite throughout, though the caller was not clearly upset and the agent's wording was brief and slightly inaccurate in places.

closing.quote: Agent: Is there anything I could help with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but did not clearly confirm the next steps with the Payments team.
